name: emailqa
description: EmailQA: turn Figma email designs into tested emails, one client folder each. Figma → MJML → pre-checks and local preview → Klaviyo [TEST] template on your test account → Litmus review and fixes → handoff to the client's Klaviyo with the client's own image links. Start with /emailqa:start.

klaviyo_api_key.title: Klaviyo TEST account private API key
klaviyo_api_key.description: Private key from your agency's Klaviyo test account (not a client's). Custom access: Images Full, Templates Full, everything else No access.

litmus_test_address.title: Litmus test address
litmus_test_address.description: Your ...@litmusemail.com address. Test emails can only go to this address and its +folder variants.
